title: Sep 27 Results: 85.7% Accuracy on 14 Games
summary: Sep 27 delivered 12-2 performance - the numbers break down our strongest day yet

content.value:
## The Numbers Tell the Story

Sep 27 was all about precision. 12 wins, 2 losses, 85.7% accuracy across 14 games. Let me walk you through exactly how each pick performed and what the data reveals about our model's strengths.

## Performance by Confidence Level

Here's what stands out: our picks above 60% confidence went 4-1 (80%), while the 50-59% range delivered 8-1 (88.9%). The Nationals pick at exactly 50% hit, and our only misses came at 54% (Rays) and 61% (Guardians).

## Analyzing the Misses

Two misses out of 14 picks. The Rays at 54% fell short against the Phillies, and the Guardians at 61% lost to the Royals. Both were division games where intangibles can override pure numbers. The Guardians miss hurts more - that was our joint-highest confidence pick of the day at 61%.

## What the Data Shows

The 85.7% accuracy rate translates to hitting 6 out of every 7 picks. Our average confidence across all picks was 57.9%, which means we weren't just making coin-flip calls - we had conviction backed by data. The tightest line was Nationals at 50%, and it still hit.

content.title: 📊 Key Takeaway
content.sub: Mid-range confidence picks (50-59%) went 8-1 • Higher confidence (60%+) went 4-1
